{{Quote|His name is ''Arca''&hellip;he's quite ''alive''&hellip;but suffering mightily under the ''crushing power'' of the dark side.|King Ommin|<ref name="Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising 2">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising 2|''Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising'' 2]]</ref>}}
'''Odojinya''', or '''Force net''', was a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] incantation that created a '''[[Force net|dark side web]]''', a [[Sith sorcery/Legends|magic]] [[Force power/Legends|technique]] favored by [[Sith sorcerer]]s. When used successfully this power would summon strands of [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] energy that would wrap around the target and ensnare them in an unbreakable mesh. The lattice of dark energy would then effectively [[Sever Force/Legends|sever]] the being's connection to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and continuously sap their strength as well.

This technique was employed by [[King/Legends|King]] [[Ommin/Legends|Ommin]] of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] to subdue [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Arca Jeth]].

It was also employed by [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Lomi Plo]] to kill a [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Shaper caste|shaper]] during the [[Mission to Myrkr]] and later during [[Swarm War]] in [[Battle of Sarm]] when she [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|dueled]] with [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. Once her victim had been ensnared, Lomi constricted the net, slicing up her victim. It was also used to torture and attempt to kill [[Ben Skywalker]] by [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Lost Tribe of the Sith]] [[High Lord (Circle of Lords)|High Lord]] [[Sarasu Taalon]] during the [[Battle in the Fallanassi village|fight]] with [[Abeloth]] on [[Pydyr]].<ref name="V">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Vortex]]''</ref>
